> I am trying to save the control node shown below because I want to delete: I fail to see how this would work, as saving the branch just would create a scene with the selected nodes, but don't modify the current node. Also, you can't delete internal nodes as the code inside the main node don't expect the user to do it and probably would end in a crash anyways. If you want to hide the scrollbars you can use the following workaround: ```gdscript extends Node2D var h_scroll var v_scroll # Called when the node enters the scene tree for the first time. func _ready() -> void: h_scroll = $GraphEdit.find_child("_h_scroll", true, false) v_scroll = $GraphEdit.find_child("_v_scroll", true, false) # Called every frame. 'delta' is the elapsed time since the previous frame. func _process(delta: float) -> void: if h_scroll: h_scroll.visible = false if v_scroll: v_scroll.visible = false ```
Can I work on this one? I think I can propose a fix
@jsudol85 We don't assign issues to specific users (unless in specific cases that manteiners judge necessary), so you can just let a message to warn you're working on a fix to avoid duplicated work.

Thanks for responding to the issue the day after I posted. 😀 It's good to see that Godot has an active userbase continually trying to improve the game engine.

For nodes such as GraphEdit and Nodes which have complex internal structures which are only accessible under "remote" inside the scene tree, maybe add a version of the node which has all the children and scripts accessible in the "local" view of the scene tree. This is a good immediate bugfix and also great for users who want flexibility with complex nodes. Adding a option inside the node add menu (don't know the name of this one) to add the internal components of a complex node as a branch in "local" scene tree view would be great for developer flexibility.

**It also helps further promote the open source flexible nature of Godot if users are able to access and customize the things that have been setup for them, further reducing the workload of future devs.** This idea is similar to one of Godot's cousins Blender, which has geometry node view for modifiers that users can copy and build from.

Thanks.

I'm not sure if save branch on remote tree is supported as some nodes rely on unexposed classes (like `GraphEdit` itself) which makes the saving fail, but also shouldn't crash either:

Yes this is true, please check the original post, I made a mistake in posting. I meant that: "save as scene tree from remote" crashes the debugger only. It does not crash Godot itself.

I agree that GraphEdit control node is a required internal child node, however, if an action is going to crash the debugger, there should at least be a warning in place.
